text: 长城证券：股东深圳新江南投资有限公司拟减持不超过公司总股本1.5%，减持期间为2026年10月29日至2027年1月28日，原因为业务发展需求及资金需求。
text_en: Great Wall Securities: Shareholder Shenzhen Xinjiangnan Investment Co., Ltd. plans to reduce its holdings by no more than 1.5% of the company's total share capital. The reduction period is from October 29, 2026 to January 28, 2027, due to business development needs and funding needs.
